newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria vote results have no impact on lev - dealer.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria vote results have no impact on lev - dealer.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev firmed to 240 per dollar in low volumes in the morning from 240-243 at Friday's close with preliminary results of the first round of presidency vote having no immediate impact on the market, dealers said.
"Trade is very thin with sporadic deals near 240 levs per dollar," a commercial bank dealer said.
The main opposition candidate Petar Stoyanov's lead over ruling Socialists' contender Ivan Marazov in Sunday's first round of presidential elections has not affected the market, dealers said.
"There are only half a dosen traders active in the market and the results have not had any impact on the (lev/dollar) exchange rate this morning so far," another dealer said.

Central bank money policy decisions amid falling forex reserves and uncertainty whether Bulgaria would win a delayed International Monetary Fund second tranche of funding would be the main market moving factors in the near term, the second dealer added.

Partial results from Sunday's vote showed Stoyanov leading with 43.65 percent but short of an absolute majority and Marazov running second with 27.07 percent. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
